full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant to disposal of this Rule may be, briefly, stated as follows:-The prosecution case, in short, is that on 18-7-2012 at 20-10 hours, one Md Zillur Rahman Chowdhury, Additional District Commissioner, Dhaka being informant lodged a First Information Report with Kotwali Police Station against the accused-petitioner alleging, inter-alga, that on 18-7-2012 at 11-00 am, the accused-petitioner entered into the room of informant. At that time, he was asked as to the reason of his coming. Upon hearing the informant, the accused-petitioner stood up from the sofa and sat on a chair beside the laptop at the southern side of table of the office room. At that moment, the accused-petitioner tried to give Taka 20,000 (Taka Twenty thousand) as bribe in a envelop saying that he wanted to give the money as honorarium so that he could take the respectful departure from the school. Then the informant took a video of the envelop in his mobile phone. At the conduct of the accused-petitioner, the informant became very perplexed and asked the accused-petitioner of the reason of giving the bribe or honorarium to him. The accused-petitioner replied that he is a retired head master of the City Corporation High School and further disclosed that he took an amount of Taka 100,000 (one lac) from the school fund unlawfully but he wanted to depart from the school without any trouble. He confessed his offence and requested him not to hand over him to the Police. After catching him red handed with illegal money, Mr Rajib Chandra Das (CA to ADC General) and Mr Md Kamal Hossain (MLSS) of DC office were present there. During that time, Begum Maksuda Hossain ADC (LA), Dhaka, Dr. Rahima Khatun, Assistant Commissioner and Executive Magistrate, Dhaka and Mr Rashedul Kader, Assistant Commissioner, Dhaka entered into his room. After knowing the matter, they watched the video and packet of the bribe money. The accused-petitioner opened the packet before them. Thereafter, the informant informed the matter to the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka and decided to lodge the case against the accused-petitioner. Hence, the FIR.
